entries.description: Twitter/X analytics dashboard showing tweet, follower, and engagement statistics for any public account.
entries.notes: Relies on the X (Twitter) API; features may be degraded or broken since X restricted third-party API access in 2023.

entries.description: Machine-learning detector for bot networks and coordinated inauthentic behaviour on Twitter/X and Bluesky.
entries.notes: As of Sept 2026 the site shows a 'Coming Soon' relaunch page (targeting May 2026); the original dashboard is offline. Recommend retiring or revisiting after relaunch.

entries.description: Retrieves archived tweets from the Wayback Machine's CDX index for a chosen date range, exportable as CSV/JSON.
Lightweight alternative Twitter/X front-end for viewing tweets and profiles without an account.
entries.notes: nitter.net returned an error (403) at check time; most public Nitter instances have gone offline since X tightened API access in 2023-2024. Recommend retiring or pointing at a currently live instance.

entries.description: Finds Instagram images by date and location using OSINT Combine's search interface.
Google search query restricted to instagram.com pages containing the word "person", used to surface profile pages.
entries.notes: This is a saved Google search query (a dork), not a dedicated tool; results drift as Google's index and query string are edited.

entries.description: Anonymous viewer and downloader for public Instagram profiles, photos, Reels, and Stories without logging in.
entries.notes: Heavy use may trigger temporary rate limits; only works on public profiles.

entries.description: Searches TikTok usernames and hashtags via browser, linking out to TikTok.com or Google results.
Extracts the upload date encoded in a TikTok video's ID from its URL.
VK's built-in search for finding people by name and birth year.
entries.notes: Full search results generally require a logged-in VK account.

entries.description: Archive of historical VKontakte profile data, including past comments, photos, and friend lists, searchable by ID or username.
entries.notes: Free demo profile only; full search requires a paid subscription.

entries.description: Foursquare City Guide's venue and place search, showing check-in activity for a location or business.
entries.notes: The search page now redirects straight to a login wall; Foursquare has scaled back its consumer app, limiting OSINT use. Recommend retiring.

entries.description: Google Custom Search Engine scoped to Telegram channel and message pages (t.me links).
entries.notes: Page is a Google CSE embed and could not be loaded directly. Coverage depends on Google indexing t.me pages, which has degraded over time; verify manually before relying on it.

entries.description: TGStat's search engine for Telegram channel posts, covering over 60 billion indexed messages with morphological and faceted filters.
entries.notes: Free tier limited to 20 recent posts, 7 days of history and no filters; full search and group search require a paid plan.

entries.description: Search engine for Telegram channels and messages by keyword.
entries.notes: Homepage now shows only a bare search box and a link to the site's own Telegram channel; unclear how much of the original search index still works. Worth re-checking before keeping.

entries.description: Open-source interface for querying Facebook's search across posts, people, photos, pages, places, videos, and events.
entries.notes: Built as a replacement after Facebook closed Graph Search; some filters need a Facebook numeric ID and results depend on Facebook's current search behaviour, which changes often.

entries.description: Checks whether an email or account was exposed in known Facebook-related data breaches.
entries.notes: Page returned only a bare title with no confirmable detail; verify the checker is still actively maintained before relying on it.

entries.description: Chrome extension that shows whether the current page has been submitted to Reddit and lets you vote, comment, or resubmit from the popup.
entries.notes: Filed under Facebook in the source list but is actually a Reddit browser extension; documented activity is old and it may not work on current Chrome versions.

entries.description: Guide and query templates for searching Facebook content via Google without being logged into Facebook.
entries.notes: The source page describes the technique as still experimental and notes pop-ups may need to be allowed.

entries.description: Exports comments from Facebook, Instagram, Twitter/X, YouTube, VK, TikTok, and Vimeo posts to Excel, CSV, or JSON.
entries.notes: Free tier is limited; scheduled exports, larger volumes and API access require a paid plan.

entries.description: Interactive WebGL visualization mapping subreddits by their overlap and connections.
entries.notes: Requires a WebGL-capable browser to render.

entries.description: Search and analytics tool for Reddit posts and comments by keyword, subreddit, or user.
entries.notes: Site returned a server error (HTTP 523, origin unreachable) at check time. Recommend verifying it is still live before keeping it in the directory; may need retiring.

entries.description: Profiles a Reddit username with karma and posting trends over time, top subreddits, word frequency, and a sentiment 'kindness meter'.
entries.notes: Limited to roughly the last 1000 comments and 1000 submissions by Reddit API restrictions.

entries.description: Multi-column dashboard-style client for browsing and posting to Reddit.
entries.notes: Page content was too sparse to confirm current features in detail; description is based on the product's known purpose.

entries.description: Daily archive of top Reddit posts, browsable by date going back through past days.
Directory of subreddits grouped into broad topic categories such as music, entertainment, and conspiracy.
Searches the comment history of a specified Reddit username.
Search engine covering posts on 4chan.org and several 4chan archive sites.
ArchiveTeam wiki page tracking 4chan archiving projects, board archivers, and site outage history.
entries.notes: Documents 4chan's April 2025 hack and week-long outage; useful for checking which board archives are currently live.

entries.description: FoolFuuka-based archive mirroring threads and images from several 4chan boards.
entries.notes: Donation-funded; coverage limited to the specific boards it mirrors.

entries.description: 4chan's own official search feature for finding posts across its boards.
entries.notes: Page returned a server error during this check; 4chan's official search has had intermittent availability since the April 2025 breach.

entries.description: Search across posts on Gab, an alt-tech Twitter-like social network.
entries.notes: Page returned a server error during this check; Gab search typically requires a logged-in account for full results.

entries.description: Timeline search aggregating posts across fringe and alt-platforms including Gab, 4chan, 8kun, Bitchute, Parler, Truth Social, and VK.
Australian discussion forum covering broadband, technology, and consumer topics.
Tripadvisor's travel discussion forums organized by destination.
entries.notes: Page timed out during this check; the forum is well known and normally accessible.

entries.description: Search engine that indexes posts across many independent online forums and message boards.
User-submitted directory of forums built on the Flarum forum software.
Craigslist's topic-based discussion forums covering hundreds of subjects and cities.
Hosting platform and directory of thousands of user-created public discussion forums and live chat rooms.
